issue_context.title: server: equip the `mt-start-sql` server code with a drain process
issue_context.body:
Epic CRDB-11087

This is a pre-req to solving #72045

To add a feature to "execute some SQL statements before a node starts draining" (#72045), we must have a draining process to start with. The `start` and `start-single-node` commands provide that, but `mt start-sql` doesn't.

**Describe the solution you'd like**

We want to provide a Drain RPC and a shutdown sequence to the `mt start-sql` server process that is using a common code path with the one used for regular DB nodes.

review_comments: FYI: We do not track instance ID in the CC operator. The operator thinks in terms of pods. Determining the instance ID of the pod we want to remove is more difficult than sending an RPC to the specific pod we want to drain. I suspect we will pass NodeId == "" when sending a Drain rpc.
